description: Corporate Secretary page sections: hero, pricing packages, the free-tools tabs, the what’s-included cards, the “Why founders choose us” carousel, the two routes to getting started, the “Why SMEs switch” bento, the shared Google Reviews slider, the shared FAQ and the final CTA. The testimonials_*, faq_* and cta_* field names repeat the Home and ROA groups’ names under different keys, which is what lets template-parts/testimonials.php, faq.php and cta.php stay page-agnostic. Everything is flat fields because ACF free has no Repeater — quantities are fixed by the layout, and empty entries are skipped rather than rendered blank. This page renders the same template parts as the two Company Incorporation pages, plus the carousel section they don’t have; the design prices two packages and ships two free tools, so the third package and the third tool are left empty on purpose.
